findings.message: Preserve native file_read line numbers on continuation chunks.
findings.rationale: file_read renders source lines as a padded number followed by a tab. This regex recognizes only path:line: prefixes, so an overlong file_read line loses its line number after the first chunk. When continuations reach separate parts, their envelopes retain the tool input's path but cannot identify the original line. Existing tests use synthetic path:line: entries and miss this native format.

Extract and retain the citation before splitting the remaining content; the current short-path tests do not exercise this case.
